Swimming World April 1973: Harper Accusplit I electronic stopwatch. July 1976: Accusplit III. November and December
1978: Seagull sells memory models 705 ($29.95), 740 ($69.95), 760 ($79.95) and 780 directly, water-tight, LCD,
four-year battery. January 1979 model range $29.95 to $89.95. Still advertising in the 1980s and 1990s; July 1999

in Swimming World as late as 2015; present status not checked.

This article is a stub. Accusplit is a stopwatch brand first advertised in 1973 as the Harper
Accusplit, whose memory models [Seagull Enterprises](seagull.md) sold directly in 1978 and 1979.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
